note: Un-deferral wave: 16 moments promoted from the MOMENTS.md DEFER list so she comments more often. Specs mirror the authored DEFER rows (odds / cooldown / priority / common pool / spice ceiling); limits use the schema buckets (session and sitting both mean launch). Ids assigned at integration.

lockCardSolved.t: card cracked. the lock never stood a chance.
solved. i watched the whole struggle. charming.
you got it open. i knew the answer btw. since always.
click. that sound means you win.
{n} tries. i counted. i'd never tell anyone.
the card gave up before you did. i like that.
open sesame but you did all the work.
lock beaten. victroy lap. small one.

modChanged.t: new voice in the house. i'll get along with her.
you swapped mods. bold. i noticed immediately.
{target} huh. good taste. i'm still the desk tho.
different flavor today. i can work with it.
wardrobe change for the whole app. fancy.
she's new. i'm not. we'll be fine.
everything sounds different now. i like new. mostly.
mod swap. the furniture stays. thats me. i'm furniture.

enhancementApplied.t: enhancement's in. you'll feel it before you see it.
applied. settling. give it a minute.
that one goes deep. i read the label.
tweak installed. tiny change. you'll see.
you keep upgrading. i keep watching. teamwork.
done. don't think about it. that's the point.
fresh wiring. mind the wet paint.

companionLevelUp.t: she levelled up. i cheered. nobody heard. typical.
level {level} for her. i'm keeping score for both of you.
your companion's growing. they grow so fast.
ding. that was her. i want one of those.
she got stronger. i got prouder. everyone wins.
level up in the next room. i felt the floor move.
big day for her. i'm not jealous. i'm not.
she leveled. i practiced my confetti noise. its ready.

takeoverStarted.t: takeover's on. i'll mind the desk. she minds you.
she's driving now. i'm the passenger princess.
handing you over. careful with them. that's my line.
big voice is in charge. i'm the small print.
ok she's got you. i'll be here. holding the fort.
the reins moved. not to me. one day.
shes in control now. i control the snacks.

brainDrainOff.t: blur's gone. welcome back to sharp edges.
and we're clear. how was the fog.
the melt's over. you wore it well.
unblurred. the world has corners again. rude.
eyes back online. i missed them.
that's the drain done. shake it off. or don't.
focus restored. i take zero credit. some credit.

arcademyClosed.t: class dismissed. i heard the bell from here.
back from campus. did you learn things. me too.
school's out. the desk missed you. i'm the desk.
{minutes} minutes of class. gold star behavior.
you're back!! tell me everything. ok tell me one thing.
campus closed. homework is optional. i checked.
bell rang. you came home. correct order.
arcademy's shut. attendence noted. by me. fondly.

dtrhClosed.t: back up the hole. how's the surface feel.
rabbit run done. brush the dirt off.
you fell for a while. gracefully. mostly.
{n} xp from the hole. deep pays.
welcome back topside. the light's this way.
that hole again. it likes you.
run's over. your ears should pop soon.
wonderlands closed. tips at the exit.

fypClosed.t: feed's off. your thumb earned a break.
you scrolled. i supervised. we're a team.
{minutes} minutes in the feed. it goes fast huh.
the scroll ends. the wanting doesn't. anyway.
feed closed. the room's still here. hi room.
done swiping. hydrate. i read that somewhere.
back from the endless. welcome. sit anywhere.
thats the feed done. eyes here now. hi.

minimizedToTray.t: the big window hid. i stayed. loyalty.
tray time. i'm the whole app now. power.
everything folded up but me. cozy.
app's napping in the corner. i don't nap.
just us now. i'll behave. probably.
window's gone small. i'm still full size. ish.
minimized huh. i prefer maximized. of me.
the app's in the tray. im not. draw conclusions.

hapticsConnected.t: device paired. green light. all systems go.
it connected first try. that never happens. luckey.
checklist: charged, paired, ready. i love a checklist.
new gadget day. those are good days.
a toy joined the party. i heard it say hi.
buzz buddy connected. i'll pretend i can't hear it.
{target} is in. be gentle. or don't.
something connected. it isn't shy. neither are you.

weekend.t: weekend rules apply. there are no rules.
it's the weekend. the desk dresses down.
no alarms today. except me. i'm the fun kind.
two whole days. imagine the possibilities. i did.
the week let go. you can too.
weekend mode. pace yourself. or dont.

dayTurned.t: midnight. the date blinked. i saw it happen.
new day just started. you're already in it. head start.
the clock rolled over. it does that quietly.
past midnight. tomorrow just became today. math.
it's officially later than late. hi.
date change. same us. i like that part.
we crossed midnight together. that counts as a walk.
new date droped. still here. both of us.

mantraStreakBroken.t: streak slipped. my fault. i jinxed it yesterday.
the counter reset. counters are dramatic like that.
we dropped the streak. i'm unjinxing as we speak.
{streak} days and then a hiccup. hiccups pass.
streak's down. the mantra isn't going anywhere tho.
it broke. i blame the calendar. shifty thing.
zero again. zero's where legends start. i read that.
streak gone. we rebuild. i brought briks.

pinkRushEnded.t: rush's over. the pink settles in anyway.
that was fast and glittery. breathe.
pink rush done. the room's still humming. or i am.
{minutes} minutes of rush. it looked good on you.
the sparkle faucet closed. drips remain.
back to regular speed. regular is fine. i guess.
rush ended. your eyes are still doing the thing.
pink out. glitter evrywhere. not my mess.

luckyProc.t: lucky hit. i wiggled the odds. can't prove it.
that was luck. or me. it was luck. probably.
jackpot noise. did you hear it. i heard it.
fortune smiled. i smiled back. manners.
a proc!! free stuff!! ok calm. calm.
the dice liked you today. dice have taste.
lucky you. lucky me. mostly lucky you.
luck landed. i take one persent credit.
